_meta.description: Team metadata for World Cup 2026 prediction — coach experience, roster stability, chemistry. These are manually curated off-field factors that affect team performance beyond ELO.

scoring.coach_wc_experience: Number of World Cups coached (0-5). Each WC adds 8 ELO.
scoring.roster_stability: Fraction of players retained from last major tournament (0.0-1.0). Formula: (stability - 0.5) × 40
scoring.recent_form_consistency: Win rate in last 10 competitive matches. Formula: (consistency - 0.5) × 30

Spain._comment: Luis de la Fuente — 1st WC as head coach. Euro 2024 winners. Very consistent form.

Argentina._comment: Scaloni — WC 2022 champion coach. Core squad intact.

France._comment: Deschamps — WC 2022 finalist. Some roster turnover.

England._comment: Tuchel (new) — 1st WC as England coach. Strong talent pipeline.

Brazil._comment: Dorival Junior — 1st WC. Injuries: Rodrygo, Militao, Estevao out. Roster disrupted.

Portugal._comment: Roberto Martinez — WC 2018 (Belgium 3rd). Strong squad depth.

Colombia._comment: Nestor Lorenzo — excellent form, dark horse candidate.

Netherlands._comment: Koeman — Xavi Simons OUT (ACL), significant midfield blow.

Germany._comment: Nagelsmann — 1st WC. Ter Stegen/Gnabry injuries. Inconsistent form.

Morocco._comment: Regragui — WC 2022 semifinalist. Strong team cohesion.

United States._comment: Pochettino (new) — host nation advantage. Inconsistent team form.

Uruguay._comment: Marcelo Bielsa — 1st WC with Uruguay. Squad transition period.

Croatia._comment: Dalic — WC 2018 finalist, 2022 semifinalist. Aging squad.

Belgium._comment: Rudi Garcia (new) — golden generation fading, rebuild phase.

Mexico._comment: Aguirre — host nation. Inconsistent but dangerous at home.
